remarks: * Highest and Best by 5pm Tuesday * Step into this classic 1940s Cape at 6 Willow Street in Norwalk, CT, where charm meets modern living. This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home spans 1,936 square feet with a thoughtful layout. The open concept main floor connects the kitchen to a large family room, creating the perfect space for relaxing or entertaining. Two spacious bedrooms and a full bath are conveniently located on the main level, with two more bedrooms and another full bath-featuring a luxurious jacuzzi tub-upstairs. The fully finished basement offers even more living space, complete with spacious playroom, laundry and two sump pumps for peace of mind. Step outside to enjoy a large deck with a retractable awning that stretches over the entire deck, providing shade for those sunny summer days. The flat backyard is perfect for outdoor gatherings, while the 1-car detached garage adds both parking and storage. Nestled between two dead-end streets, this home offers both privacy and a peaceful setting, yet is close to everything. Just minutes from the East Norwalk train station, Stew Leonard's, and more, you'll have easy access to all the best Norwalk has to offer--and have full access to Norwalk's beaches. With central air and the character of 1940s construction, this home is a rare find. If you're looking for a blend of charm, space, and convenience, 6 Willow Street has it all. Don't miss the chance to make this gem your own!
